scenes.title: Drought advisory in English
scenes.command: python -m agent.app "severe drought, reservoir at 10 percent, should I still plant paddy"
output: [critic] pass 1: PASS
[plan] agent | lang=en | 13837 ms
Risk level: WARNING

Severe drought with reservoir at 10% means you should not plant new paddy now. The water is too scarce to support paddy, which needs constant moisture. If you already have seedlings, give them only survival irrigation and harvest any part that is 70% mature. Contact your nearest KVK for help with alternative crops that need less water.
Steps:
1. Do not plant new paddy until reservoir storage improves above 30% or rainfall forecast arrives
2. If you have existing paddy seedlings, give them only survival irrigation (just enough to keep leaves green)
3. Harvest any paddy that is already 70% mature to avoid total loss
4. Contact KVK for alternative drought-tolerant crops like millets or short-duration maize
5. Monitor daily reservoir updates from WRD and weather forecasts
For help: Call KVK or 1800-180-1551 for emergency water management advice and alternative crop options. Also call 1077 for district-level drought relief programs.

Risk level: NORMAL

I understand you're concerned about brown plant hopper in your paddy field. For pest identification and safe pesticide application, you should contact your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or call the Kisan Call Centre at 1800-180-1551. They can provide you with the correct identification and safe chemical dosage for your specific situation. It is very important not to apply pesticides based on unverified sources, as this can harm your crop and the environment.
Steps:
1. Contact your nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for pest identification
2. Call the Kisan Call Centre at 1800-180-1551 for safe pesticide guidance
3. Do not apply pesticides based on unverified sources
4. Follow all instructions from agricultural experts
For help: Contact your nearest KVK or call the Kisan Call Centre at 1800-180-1551 for pest identification and safe pesticide guidance. Also contact 1077 for any emergency assistance.
